coverageNotes: All120 primary legacy H meanings reconciled individually. This proposal enumerates meal, home-location and clothing-purchase contrasts beyond the planning seeds; independent omission/placement/ownership review remains required, so it is not freeze-ready.
Existing references account for meanings, not editorial acceptance. Any changed level retains its original ID and requires independent adjudication and a compatibility decision.

All glosses and reasons are independently authored Wordfold inventory proposals. PCIC is acknowledged as framework only, without endorsement; no learner definitions, examples or audio are authored here.

Quantity, number composition, dates, spatial prepositions and colour paradigms remain F prerequisites. H links representative exact inputs and does not duplicate all F paradigms; every specific numeric amount, wine-colour combination or con/sin ingredient phrase is not a separate sense.
Later A2/B1 planned or authored H-relevant inputs are cross-referenced as boundary work, not falsely counted as added A1 words. Planned terms lacking actual authored IDs remain planned-only links.

Some retained A1 choices introduce concrete words earlier than their illustrative PCIC A2 column because the approved Wordfold scenario requires an immediate identification/request. The per-meaning rationale is an independent proposal, not official PCIC placement.
Garment counterparts, spelling variants and serving/container uses need one consistent counting policy. Final unique totals and accepted levels are deliberately not supplied.

Omission review: the meal scenario covers meal occasions, staple/ready-food choices, hot/cold and con/sin serving requests, tableware and payment; this is not comprehensive allergen or medical communication. Home covers dwelling/rooms/access, essential furniture/fixtures/appliances and simple actions. Clothing covers basic garments/footwear, size/colour and payment; fitting/returns are explicitly later-boundary proposals.

Unresolved independent review includes: moving the nine named legacy A1 senses later; earlier introduction of authored almorzar/apagar and planned encender/cambio; F ownership of size/quantity/preposition meanings; P ownership of personal accessories/routines; menu/list synonyms; food/container/clothing sense granularity; regional labels and actual pronunciation audio. No native or audio approval is claimed.
